name: microduck-sim
title: Microduck in Pollen's browser simulator (MuJoCo, ONNX walking policy)
notes: For the test app (app/): Pollen's simulator at https://huggingface.co/spaces/pollen-robotics/microduck-simulator, revision ad9d41a7.
Its walker is commanded up to vx 0.25 m/s forward and 1 rad/s. Below about 0.22 m/s it does not start walking, so cruise is the maximum.
achieved: steady speeds measured in the simulator (forward 0.11 m/s at 0.25, in-place left turn 0.26 rad/s at 1, sideways 0.06 m/s at 0.3). Walking starts after about 1.5 s.
Backward walking and in-place right turns barely respond in the simulator: the app shows the gap between the plan and the physics.
gait: the simulator caps backward walking at 0.2 m/s (vx_backward), under the 0.22 m/s the walker needs to start, so it only shakes on the spot. The bridge turns around and walks forward instead.
Never drive the real robot with this profile: the app always runs real robots with their own profile (microduck).

skills.kick_left: kick a ball with the left foot
skills.kick_right: kick a ball with the right foot
skills.ground_pick: bend down and pick something up from the ground
skills.sit_toggle: sit down, or stand up again if already sitting
